method_description: Preserve whole vector lanes; choose scalar owners with root-conditioned tree DP, then materialize a contention-aware V word. One deterministic construction, zero online evaluator calls.
case_selection: Only016k2: fixed-plan lower bounds already exceed achieved incumbents for k4/k5, pruning them without E0. Development mechanism test, not holdout.
failure_policy: First unsuccessful or unverified attempt stops; no retry.
resources: One local macOS worker after P3 explicitly yields window, one solver plus one final E0, aggregate120s, sampled4GiB RSS; no Colab.
offline_costs: 9 synthetic tests and3 single static constructions recorded separately; root independently recomputed all3 bounds. No training or online score tables.
comparison: Against existing vector k2 M4170750 at data d15f27fe3ad41be63c9e837af0a7afae440eca66, fixed-plan new LB4026386. No old E0 rerun. Preserve a loss if observed.
